subject: Recap & scheduling: ACME evaluation kickoff
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Aug 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Recap & next steps from discovery — propose eval kickoff

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for taking time to walk through Acme's use case today. Quick recap from my side so we're aligned and I've captured the right success criteria for the evaluation kickoff: 

- Goal: Validate that Redwood can reduce latency on your transactional summarization pipeline while keeping token costs below your current provider.
- Key success criteria: (1) 95th percentile latency < 600ms for 512-token prompts, (2) cost per 1k tokens <= $0.80, (3) no regression on your 10-sample regression prompt set.
- Technical constraints: sensitive PII in prompts (redacted pipeline required), on-prem KV cache for long-term sessions, RBAC required for logs.

Next step: schedule an evaluation kickoff (trial plan, prompt set, success criteria, and roles). Proposed 1hr slots next week (PT):
- Tue Aug 17: 10:00–11:00 or 14:00–15:00
- Wed Aug 18: 09:00–10:00 or 11:00–12:00
- Thu Aug 19: 10:00–11:00

I've attached a draft evaluation plan (acme-eval-plan-v1.pdf) with an initial prompt set and suggested roles. If you can confirm a slot and any additional attendees (SRE/security), I'll send a calendar invite and share a doc with the final success criteria and prompt set.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0118

Attachment: acme-eval-plan-v1.pdf

Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap. That aligns with what we discussed. We'd like to move forward with the evaluation. Thu Aug 19 10:00–11:00 PT works best for the team. I'll be on the call and I've looped in Tom (engineering lead) to join as well. We'll also ask one of our SREs to join — I'll confirm the SRE name in a follow-up later today.

Couple requests before the kickoff:
- Can you share the final success criteria and the prompt set 48 hrs before the call? We want to run a few internal dry-runs.
- Any pre-reqs for data handling or a short security checklist we should review?

Appreciate it — looking forward to the kickoff.

— Alex
